title: Filter dynamic quotation reports by customer salesperson and currency
description: A salesperson narrows the existing quotation conversion designer by a positive optional customer ID, a trimmed salesperson-name keyword of at most 80 characters and a finite original-currency selector (blank means all; a known Currency enum code or explicit unknown bucket). Define and normalize one optional application filter DTO and preserve the existing method call shape via a compatible optional filter argument after its mandatory scope argument. Validate before quotation reads, apply parameterized EF predicates to the current-user scoped date query before the 2001-row source limit and before conversion aggregation; never filter only the already aggregated/page rows. Unknown currency means persisted undefined enum values, never fallback to CNY; reject invalid filter tokens. Preserve date, selected-field order, paging and current conversion rules. Designer resets to page one when filters change and retains all filters on preview, Excel and PDF; export context must accurately label applied filters and existing denied/limit/error states. Reuse existing enum/domain mapping unchanged. Development only: reuse current authenticated ERP identity, the existing quotation menu and freshly resolved SalespersonDataScopeService; audit every endpoint through existing OperationLogMiddleware. No permission expansion, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table or business writes, new entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure edits, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env changes, deployment, irreversible operations or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and work. Run focused in-memory/service/API/export/UI source-contract tests and configured safe Release build/test; mark unavailable external environments blocked rather than inventing success.
acceptance_criteria: Customer ID, salesperson keyword and finite currency filters are validated before quotation reads and applied after ERP customer scope but before source limits and aggregation; unauthorized/null-customer rows do not leak to restricted users.

The designer resets pagination on filter changes and preserves normalized filters, dates and field order for preview/Excel/PDF; exported filter context and denied/validation/empty/source-limit feedback are accurate.

Focused service/API/UI/export tests cover filter combinations, undefined currencies, limits after filtering, revocation, unmapped users and compatibility; existing tests and safe Release build/test pass.
